evidence_excerpt: CoolVu of Des Moines. 1901 Bell Ave. Suite 16, Des Moines, IA 50315. Phone: (515) 559-3565. Architectural window tinting, privacy and switchable window films, decorative films, glass security, and solar films.
notes: Official page https://www.coolvu.com/des-moines-window-film/ (also reached from https://www.coolvu.com/desmoines/) names CoolVu of Des Moines, states it provides home window film tinting and installation of smart glass, privacy, and security film for residential and commercial work, lists phone 515-559-3565 with office hours Monday-Friday 9AM-5PM, and headings the contact as Owner Alex Orozco. That page does not print a street address or a business email. The HBA of Greater Des Moines member page prints 1901 Bell Ave., Suite 16, Des Moines, IA 50315, the same phone, links the official Des Moines page, and lists Alex Orozco with a blank title. The CoolVu locator record names the same phone and says only Serving Des Moines, IA and surrounding areas. No published company email was found on these pages, so the supplied alex.orozco@coolvu.com address was not used. The phone is labeled Phone and sits with office hours; it is not labeled a mobile. The supplied industry label was HVAC; the verified field trade is window film installation.

No official company website and no published company email were found, so bdthurman@qwestoffice.net was not used.
